text: West Plains native Stan Utley was inducted into the Missouri Golf Hall of Fame, announced Oct. 26, for his career as a pro golfer, instructor and junior golf advocate. A hole-in-one of an honor.
Missouri Independent reporter Rudi Keller's campaign finance review shows Republicans are well provisioned in tight legislative races, even as Democrats predict voter discontent will help them.
MoDOT picked rural interstate stretches where the speed limit will rise from 70 to 75 mph under a new state law. Your lead foot just got a raise.

Missouri State Board of Education members are divided over the planned A-through-F grades for every public school and district; board member Vincent Schoemehl Jr. questioned whether the grades would help struggling schools. Even the board is grading on a curve.
Missouri Interim Education Commissioner Stacey Preis resigned Oct. 20, effective immediately, as the State Board of Education searches for a permanent leader. The job posting just got a rewrite.
